lessons.pinoy-english: tl-only lesson (profile tl.md §8 'add' / §4.8 / §2 classes A, C, D / §9 Ingles-Pinoy list): Philippine English usages that mislead abroad (CR, open the light, for a while, go down, It's traffic, brownout, ref, aircon, commute, salvage, gimmick, bold), small grammar habits (fill out, cope with, result in, based on, share with, in my opinion, make a mistake, uncountable luggage / furniture / advice) and local words that are fine (jeepney, barangay, sari-sari store, pasalubong); placed after smalltalk via profile.json lessonOrder.after; deck Mga bitag ng Ingles-Pinoy; no ko-en counterpart (replaces the ko-only konglish lesson in more/a1.js; mirrors zh chinglish, ja katakana-english, id indo-english)
lessons.aspect-tense: tl-only lesson (profile tl.md §8 additions, §4.3): maps the three Tagalog aspect forms (tapos na / ginagawa / gagawin pa: kumain, kumakain, kakain) and the enclitics na / pa onto the English tenses each can become, plus the two rules Tagalog lacks (the verb always carries the time; base form after did / does / will / to); placed after perfect via profile.json lessonOrder.after; linked to the deck «Kuwentuhan»; new body, check and 16-item practice set that satisfies the standing rule article-plural (§7)
